how.title: How accuracy is measured
how.shifts: Only completed shifts count. A shift belongs to the date it starts on: shift 1 runs 08:00–20:00 and shift 2 runs 20:00–08:00 the next morning (India time).
how.actual: Actual is the existing platform's fuel total for the shift, copied into 2.0 every hour. A shift it has no figure for is not counted.
how.forecast: Forecast is the figure issued for the shift before it ended. A shift with no forecast is left out of the score, never counted as a forecast of zero, and the note under the tile says how many.
how.inShift: The in-shift forecast at 2, 4 or 6 hours is the newest re-forecast made by that point in the shift: litres burned so far plus the forecast’s share of the hours left. A shift with none by then is left out of that checkpoint.
how.formula: Accuracy = 100 − (miss ÷ actual litres × 100), rounded, and never below 0. A machine that burned nothing has no percentage: it shows “Didn’t run”.
how.levels: “Count misses per” decides what a miss is. Shift: every machine-shift’s gap counts. Day: each machine’s day total against its forecast day total, so an over-forecast morning can offset an under-forecast night; the fleet tiles use the whole fleet’s day totals. Whole range: one total against the other.
how.fleet: The tiles add up only the machines that burned fuel in the dates picked, their forecast litres included.
how.didntRun: “Didn’t run” means the machine burned 0 litres across the dates picked.
